author: Lycorais
body:
So guys I am basically quitting MC because of these 3 reasons:
MC got boring 4 me
All my 'friends' kind of got less active on mc and some left.
I might get a ps4 which will have awesome games.

Zaieh/Totteh/bob (ik): although you left avicus before me and might not read this, I am very thankful I have known you.
You were the leader of my 1st joined team, you were the 1st one I talked with on skype/TS.

Sam/Dqrkshine: hello boi continue improving in MC.

Ted/Wifie: <:3

Phill/ziqyx: start dreaming stop mening.
Jk continue what u are doing.

xWalter: hai noël, Mr.Walterbalter

1 thing for Kevin; sorry that I was rude at the beginning when I met you, hope you get Mod or something.

Bye

replies.author: RATTLEWARRIOR
replies.body:
So long, farewell,auf wiedersehen, good night.
I hate to go and leave this pretty sight.

So long, farewell auf wiedersehen, adieu
Adieu, adieu, to yieu and yieu and yieu.

So long, farewell, au revoir, auf wiedersehen.
I'd like to stay and taste my first champagne
Yes?
"no."

So long, farewell, auf wiedersehen, goodbye
I leave and heave a sigh and say goodbye

I'm glad to go, I cannot tell a lie

I flit, I float, I fleetly flee, I fly
The sun has gone to bed and so must I

So long, farewell, auf wiedersehen, goodbye
Goodbye, goodbye, goodbye


Goodbye
